# The Art Sherpa

> A comprehensive platform for beginner-friendly painting tutorials and community art education across acrylic, watercolor, and zen doodling mediums.

The Art Sherpa provides free and premium painting courses, video tutorials, and community resources led by experienced instructors. The platform includes seasonal challenges like Acrylic April, a paint party business licensing program, and an active community with exclusive patron classes.

## Key Topics

- Acrylic painting
- Watercolor painting
- Zen doodling
- Beginner-friendly tutorials
- Video library
- Acrylic April challenge
- Paint party business
- Community classes
- Art templates
- Patron exclusive content
- Cinnamon Cooney
- The Art Sherpa Community
- Painting fundamentals
- Seasonal challenges
- Drawing templates

## Video Tutorials & Courses

- [Videos](https://theartsherpa.com/videos): Video library with beginner painting tutorials including acrylic, watercolor, and zen doodling
- [Beginner Acrylic Painting Course](https://theartsherpa.com/BeginnerAcrylicPaintingCourse): Free beginner acrylic painting course with step-by-step fundamentals

## Community & Events

- [Calendar](https://theartsherpa.com/calendar): Schedule of upcoming painting tutorials and community events
- [Acrylic April Challenge](https://theartsherpa.com/acrylicapril): 30-day Acrylic April painting challenge for community engagement
- [The Art Sherpa Community](https://theartsherpa.com/theartsherpacommunity/gallery/patron-exclusive-classes-image-gallery-join-here-https-theartsherpacom-patron/all): Patron-exclusive art classes and image gallery in community platform
- [Community File Library](https://theartsherpa.com/theartsherpacommunity/file): Community file library with downloadable art templates and resources

## Resources & Tools

- [Traceables](https://theartsherpa.com/traceables): Downloadable drawing templates and traceable art resources

## Business Programs

- [Paint Party Licensing & Certification](https://theartsherpa.com/labs): Paint party business licensing and artist certification program
